**Opened PR #898 (slice A of #887, Closes #897): the lane planner, 8 commits, fresh review corrections applied before push; PR B pending slice-B review and rebase onto A**

**What**: PR #898 opened 2026-09-09 from feat/issue-897-featmemory-the-lane-planner (worktree brain-issue-897), head 4973ce4a: 04b50227 tests, 96f18830 canonicalOrNull move, 094d1b11 planner, da3b874a SDD contract docs, 5b8e5c27 pins (C1–C4), 05e9a7dc secret-group reporting fixes (C5/C6/E1/E2/E6), a0f546bc one canonicalOrNull + purity guard + drop commit field (C7/E3/E5), 4973ce4a record rec-fa2869c4792a5941. Cold review launched in background.

**Why**: #887 split at the planner seam (maintainer chose two PRs stacked to main with a sub-ticket #897 for slice A, since issue-link requires a closing keyword on every PR to main and PR A must not close #887).

**Where**: PR #898; branch B feat/issue-887-featmemory-the-lane-collector-worktree-p (worktree brain-issue-887) holds slice B (976230f4, 51d079c8, 658ba9d5, 4e68cc0e) on top of 094d1b11 and must be REBASED onto branch A's head before PR B (Closes #887); B's worktree has untracked openspec artifacts (tasks.md ticked B1–B4, W1) that will collide with A's committed copies — move aside, rebase, reapply ticks.

**Learned**: slice B's collect.mjs builds its own return object and never reads plan.commit, so dropping `commit` from the planner was safe. The three-dot note was posted on #889 (issuecomment-5610489542).
